content: {"episode_id":"ep-05089","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of rapid heart rate, raising clinical suspicion for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia. Cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) is indicated to capture the rhythm during these intermittent symptomatic events and guide further management. Reconsideration is requested on the basis of this documented indication; the supplied note does not document that less intensive monitoring was attempted and deemed insufficient."}
